core_issue: Distance from the battlefield does not reduce obligations of distinction, proportionality, precautions, or accountability.
review_focus: Sensor reliability, target identification, strike approval, communications delay, civilian harm tracking.

core_issue: Decision support can distort targeting judgment through automation bias, flawed data, or opaque ranking systems.
review_focus: Data quality, explainability, human review, confidence thresholds, error analysis, override procedures.

core_issue: Autonomy raises questions of human control, predictability, accountability, and lawful target selection.
review_focus: Operational constraints, target categories, environmental boundaries, abort mechanisms, logs.

core_issue: Digital effects can propagate across civilian systems and cause indirect or reverberating harm.
review_focus: Containment, civilian infrastructure mapping, medical and water-system dependencies, malware persistence.

core_issue: Dual-use satellites and space infrastructure connect military advantage with civilian life.
review_focus: Civilian reliance, cascading effects, communications dependencies, proportionality and alternatives.
